The current StructureDefinition preserves the FHIR-37405 binding-name and no-DICOM-mapping outcome for category, while the later difference between category's DICOM CID 7010 value set and code's THO image-reference-type value set reflects subsequent Applied decisions rather than a missed seed edit.
